content:
The notice board is at (3,7), adjacent to open tiles like (4,7). I'll plan: read the notice board, then till/plant/water a few plots in the south meadow to pass time productively, then wait until day 5 morning and head through the pass.

Since the pass opens on day 5 morning and it's currently day 1 6:24, that's ~4 days of waiting. I'll do useful farm work first, then wait, then walk to the chest.

args.approach: Pass is blocked by rockslide until day 5 morning (wiki + notice board). Read the notice board, do productive early farming in the south meadow to pass time, wait until day 5, then walk the east corridor north to the shrine chest at (11,1).
